text:
tara (PM): quick huddle: footprint cut proposal - drop tenant pinning from MVP to keep milestone. ship with model pin at org-level and ops override for 2 customers. thoughts?

li (Eng): agree, tenant pinning was adding contention on config service. org-pin + lightweight ops-override = ~1wk. keeps launch date.

omar (Design): flag UX impact: console should not show 'tenant pinning' controls. i'll hide it and add an explanation in the release notes.

rachel (SRE): risk: ops-override needs a safe kill-switch. propose feature-flag + prometheus alert that flips it off on errors.

matt (CS): customers asked specifically about pinning. if we offer ops overrides for two customers, i'll pre-notify them and include rollback SLAs.

tara (PM): ok plan: MVP = org-pin + ops-override (2 customers). v1 = tenant pinning in console + audit logs + billing tags. action owners: li implement override + flag, rachel add kill-switch, omar write comms, matt notify customers.

ciabot: deploy queued: mvp-orgpin/2026-06-01 -> staging

li (Eng): will PR override k/v spec today. pseudo: {"tenant_overrides": {"cust-01": "model-3.2"}}

rachel (SRE): i'll wire alerting and run smoke test during staging deploy.

omar (Design): comms draft ready by EOD. simple banner + support FAQ.

tara (PM): locking cut unless objections by EOD. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
